fusions.name: Cold Deck
fusions.desc: Flicks a bolt that deals 20 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 50% chance to turn it against its allies for 4 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Switcheroo
fusions.desc: Deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and stuns each for 0.8 seconds, with a 40% chance to turn each against its allies for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Return to Sender
fusions.desc: Turns afflictions back on whoever inflicts them: each debuff laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to its source instead, for 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 10% while it holds.

fusions.name: Loaded Dice
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a blow that would hit you is rolled a second time against your dodge chance, and the second roll stands.
